notes: The opening 'When' is added: hem 'im-yevus is juxtaposed with no conjunction morpheme in it (rule 55).

'this city of the Jebusites': the demonstrative pronoun takes the one written determiner, its agreement article is unrepresented, the article on hayvusi takes the 'the' before its own word, and the construct 'ir keeps only its own noun (rules 41, 29, 19).
